body:
Resolves #754.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `packages/review-calibration/bin/review-calibration.mjs` registers the emergency planted-file restore handler on `SIGTERM` and `SIGHUP` in addition to `SIGINT`.
2. `packages/review-calibration/README.md` documents `SIGTERM` and `SIGHUP` alongside `SIGINT` and updates the `--review-cmd` description and smoke-test example.
3. Unit/integration tests in `packages/review-calibration/test/inflight-restore.test.mjs` verify that `SIGTERM` and `SIGHUP` restore planted files when handled in-process.
title: review-calibration: restore planted files on SIGTERM and SIGHUP (#754)
